let NextDNSAnalytics_Parser = () {
    union isfuzzy=true NextDNSAnalytics_CL,
    datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, profileId:string, metric:string, name:string, status:string, queryCount:long, percentage:real)[]
    | extend TimeGenerated = coalesce(todatetime(column_ifexists('TimeGenerated', datetime(null))), now())
    | extend profileId = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('profileId', ''), column_ifexists('profileId_s', '')))
    | extend metric = tostring(column_ifexists('metric', ''))
    | extend queryCount = tolong(coalesce(column_ifexists('queryCount', 0), column_ifexists('queries', 0)))
    | extend percentage = toreal(column_ifexists('percentage', 0.0))
    | extend _name = tostring(column_ifexists('name', '')), _status = tostring(column_ifexists('status', ''))
    | extend itemName = iff(isnotempty(_name), _name, _status)
    | extend EventVendor = 'NextDNS', EventProduct = 'NextDNS'
    | project TimeGenerated, EventVendor, EventProduct, profileId, metric, itemName, queryCount, percentage
};
NextDNSAnalytics_Parser
